title: La regola dell'1%: diventa migliore ogni giorno
description: The stickman discovers that small improvements every day can completely transform his life.

title: Smetti di aspettare la motivazione
description: The stickman keeps waiting to feel motivated, until he realizes that he needs to take action even when he doesn't feel like it.

title: La tua zona di comfort ti sta trattenendo
description: A metaphorical comfort zone protects the stickman, but prevents him from growing. He decides to step outside it.

title: Nessuno verrà a salvarti
description: The stickman waits for someone else to solve his problems, until he realizes that he must take responsibility for his own life.

title: La disciplina cambierà la tua vita
description: The stickman transforms his chaotic daily life through discipline, routines, and consistency.

title: Non mollare prima che le cose migliorino
description: After experiencing repeated failures, the stickman is about to give up. He decides to keep going and eventually sees the first signs of progress.

title: Smetti di paragonarti agli altri
description: The stickman feels inadequate while watching other people succeed, until he realizes that he needs to focus on his own journey.

title: Un giorno o giorno uno?
description: The stickman keeps postponing his goals, telling himself 'one day I'll do it,' until he decides that today will be his Day One.

title: Il potere di rialzarsi
description: The stickman fails repeatedly, falls down, gets back up, and learns that true success isn't about never falling.

title: Il tuo io futuro ti sta guardando
description: The stickman encounters a future version of himself and realizes that the decisions he makes today are shaping his future.
